slides.texte_overlay:
how to become disgustingly overeducated
(because knowing random sh*t is hot)

pick one weird topic a month.

volcanoes, opera, ancient rome.
go way too deep.

read the wikipedia page of everything you watch.

movies, songs, places.
the real story is always wilder.

keep a list of « wait, what? » facts.

your notes app becomes a treasure chest.

tell people what you learned.

this morning i learned that agatha christie once disappeared for eleven days in 1926.
nobody at dinner could stop asking questions.

this morning, the Sophia app taught me that agatha christie once disappeared for eleven days in 1926.

stay curious, not smug.

knowing stuff is hot.
showing off isn't.
